correctness.rationale: A TOIDS in a cycle has a 2-packing complement. For three blocks, each coalition edge is equivalent to 2-packing of the omitted block. The exhaustive star/triangle coalition-graph dichotomy yields the multiplicities 2 and 6. Exact 7-state and 3-state trace formulas count respectively colored packing pairs and their forbidden packed unions; exact characteristic polynomials prove the recurrences. The sole triangle coloring is three-periodic, so it exists iff 3 divides n. The dominance of the quartic Perron eigenvalue proves the asymptotic. The standalone verifier computes characteristic polynomials and independently enumerates all unordered three-partitions for n=3..12; those checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

The new claim instead counts every maximizing unordered partition, separates its possible coalition graphs, and derives full-order recurrences and an asymptotic. Prior relevant cycle total outer-independent domination gives a minimum vertex-set size only, and prior ordinary coalition-graph cycle work concerns a different predicate. Mathematical record database semantic queries and literature/sequence searches did not identify an equivalent or dominating enumeration. Historical priority is provisional and must be independently confirmed.

value.rationale: Exact enumeration of all maximizers of a newly introduced coalition invariant on every cycle is a natural completion of a scalar extremal theorem. The path/triangle split reveals a rare congruence-constrained exceptional optimizer, and transfer-matrix factorization reduces the full infinite family to three short recurrences and an explicit exponential growth constant. These counts are not an arbitrary small parameter slice or a known table recomputation.
